newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Newell bids 197 mln SKR for rest of Acrimo.
newsitem.headline: Newell bids 197 mln SKR for rest of Acrimo.

text.p: U.S. company Newell Co said on Tuesday it was bidding 197 million crowns or 170 crowns per share for the outstanding B-series shares in Sweden's Acrimo, which mainly produces curtain rods.
Newell placed the bid through its subsidiary Sani Sweden AB, the company said in a statement.
"Newell thinks that Acrimo and the European market for window products will be able to benefit from a merger of Newell's and Acrimo's operations," the company said.

The bid represented a 48 percent premium calculated on Acrimo's share price before the letter of intent was published on January 30, and a 19 percent premium on the average share price of 143 crowns in the period June 3 to August 18, Newell said.
The offer period will run from August 27 to September 19.
Following Newell's acquisition in May of Cooper Industries' Kirsch window products unit, the U.S. company boosted its stake in Acrimo to 53.7 percent of capital and 77.8 percent of votes.
Acrimo thereby became a subsidiary of Newell.

"The offer is both a correct industrial solution for Acrimo and an excellent opportunity for its shareholders to sell at an attractive price," Dale Matschullat, vice president at Newell and board member of Sani Sweden AB, said.
